examples.name: Uncontrolled
examples.description: One control for a date and a time over a single value.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.description: The parent owns the combined date-and-time value.

examples.name: Constrained + coarse minutes
examples.description: Date constraints go to the calendar; minuteStep to the time selector.
examples.jsx: <DateTimePicker min={new Date(2026, 2, 1)} max={new Date(2026, 2, 31)} minuteStep={15} aria-label='When' />

examples.name: Translated
examples.description: dateLabel and timeLabel name the halves; each half's built-in text passes through (dateDialogLabel, timeDialogLabel, and Time Picker's own label props); locale sets the month and weekday names.
examples.jsx:
<Field label="Audiencia">
  <DateTimePicker
    locale="es"
    dateLabel="Fecha"
    timeLabel="Hora"
    dateDialogLabel="Elegir una fecha"
    timeDialogLabel="Elegir una hora"
    confirmLabel="Confirmar"
    cancelLabel="Cancelar"
    hoursLabel="Horas"
    minutesLabel="Minutos"
    meridiemLabel="a. m./p. m."
    amLabel="a. m."
    pmLabel="p. m."
  />
</Field>

antiExamples.name: Date only
antiExamples.reason: Use Date Picker when there is no time to capture.

antiExamples.name: Unlabelled group
antiExamples.reason: Give the group an accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby.
